# Project Plans  (options package: horizon_agentic_project_planning)
Track multi-session bodies of work as **project plans** — six living docs (detail, status,
status archive, current orientation, action log, bugs/debt) sharing an `NNN_*-<slug>.md` prefix
under the target repo's `docs/project_plans/`. Never in AIOS system dirs — always the project's
own repo.
`/project-plan new <slug>` scaffold · `manage <NNN>` upkeep · `status <NNN>` cold-read ·
`close <NNN>` wind down through the four pre-close gates.
Kit + lifecycle specs: `$HORIZON_SYSTEM/skills_bin/project-plan/kit/`.
